title: SSC CHSL Tier 1 — 14 August 2023 (Shift 2)
subTitle: Official Memory-Based Previous Year Paper (11:45 AM - 12:45 PM)

questions.questionText:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the
given sentence.
One of them who were hidings at the back of a rock fired at the villagers.
options: one of them who were hiding behind a rock
one of them who was hide behind a rock
one of them who hiding behind a rock
one of them who was hiding behind a rock
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (D).

questions.questionText:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words underlined in the given
sentence.
I can’t believe that I am doing this ordinary and dull task.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (C).

questions.questionText:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in superlative degree of
comparison.
It was probably the happy afternoon of her life.
options: This afternoon of her life was the happy.
It was an happier afternoon in their life before that.
It was probably the happiest afternoon of her life.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (D).

questions.questionText:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct
order to form a meaningful sentence.
P. but results in widespread hunger, death and social unrest
Q. some of the causes of famine in that region
R. drought, floods, war and economic instability are
S. which not only causes severe shortage of food
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (A).

questions.questionText:
